FX-BLOCKLOAD-001.says: The settings as they start: Completion 0, Scans 4, Start Cleared on: nothing shows yet.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-002.says: Completion 100: every pass done, the drawing as it is.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-003.says: Scans 3, Start Cleared off, Completion 0: the roughest picture, blocks 8 pixels square, as Mosaic size 8 draws it (FX-MOSAIC-009).

FX-BLOCKLOAD-004.says: Scans 2, Completion 20: three passes, the first, blocks 4 wide, a little over half under way: its first row of blocks, rows 0 to 3, drawn; below it nothing yet.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-005.says: Scans 2, Completion 50: the second pass, blocks 2 wide, half under way: rows 0 to 3 in blocks 2 wide, rows 4 to 9 still in blocks 4 wide.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-006.says: Scans 2, Start Cleared off, Completion 50: two passes, the first done and the last not begun: all in blocks 2 wide, Mosaic size 2.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-007.says: Scans 2, Start Cleared off, Completion 78: the last pass a little over half way: rows 0 to 4 the drawing as it is, rows 5 to 9 in blocks 2 wide.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-008.says: Scans 1, Start Cleared off, Completion 0: blocks 2 wide.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-009.says: Scans 16, Start Cleared off, Completion 0: one block, the whole drawing's mean (FX-MOSAIC-007).

FX-BLOCKLOAD-011.says: Bilinear, Scans 2, Start Cleared off, Completion 0: the blocks 4 wide blended smoothly into each other instead of flat.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-013.says: Bilinear, Completion 100: the drawing as it is.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-014.says: Completion keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, Scans 2: frame 0 nothing; frame 1 the first pass three quarters done, rows 0 to 7 in blocks 4 wide; frame 2 FX-BLOCKLOAD-005; frame 3 the last pass a quarter done, rows 0 and 1 as drawn, the rest in blocks 2 wide; frame 4 the drawing.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-015.says: Scans keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 3 at frame 4, eased past its end, Start Cleared off, Completion 0: blocks 2 wide at frame 0, then 4 or 8.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-016.says: FX-BLOCKLOAD-005 moved three pixels right: the blocks are laid from the drawing's own corner, so they move with it.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-017.says: After a directional blur (direction 90, length 4) that grows the layer two pixels on every side, Scans 2, Completion 50: the blocks are laid from the drawing's corner, and the pass's rows of blocks are the grown layer's, the two grown rows above the drawing a short row of their own.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-018.says: Completion 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-019.says: Completion -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-020.says: Scans 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-021.says: Scans 17, above 16. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-022.says: Start Cleared "yes", not on or off. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-023.says: Bilinear "On", in capitals, not the word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BLOCKLOAD-024.says: Completion keyed to 150 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
